narrativeProgression.description: Steve discusses the cyclical nature of poverty and the compounding effect of bad decisions or circumstances. He highlights his experience working with people in need and his realization of the challenges they face in breaking the cycle of poverty.
Steve emphasizes how easily people can fall into a cycle of poverty.
He shares his experience working with impoverished individuals, particularly through HUD.
He connects his work experience to a deeper understanding of the challenges faced by children growing up in poverty.
Steve describes the realization of perpetual and multigenerational poverty and the struggle to escape it.
He concludes by stating how his experience motivated him to volunteer and work with organizations supporting adults overcoming difficult circumstances.
